title: Introduce token-cohort metrics and span-anchoring dashboard
author: Asha Mehta
description: Motivation: long-tail token cost and latency issues are often driven by small cohorts of invocations with unusual token semantics or unexpected KV-cache churn. This PR adds two complementary observability primitives: (1) token-cohort metrics that group invocations by token-level features (e.g., first-token entropy, prefix-match ratio, kv-cache hit-seq) and produce cohorted histograms for cost/latency; (2) span-anchoring annotations that attach a stable anchor id to spans so related logs, traces, and dashboard panels can be joined deterministically across sampling boundaries. What changed: implemented a lightweight token feature extractor in the runtime tracing path, emitted cohort tags on spans and metrics, added cohorted histogram rollups to the telemetry ingestion pipeline, and created a new Dashboard: "Span Anchors & Token Cohorts" which correlates cohorts against per-route cost, p95/p99 latency, and KV-cache miss sequences. Rollout plan: feature gated by telemetry.flag.token_cohort and enabled in staging for 48h before progressive rollout to canary and then full-hosted; dashboards are available in console immediately. Backwards compatibility: cohorts are additional labels only; no schema-breaking changes. Observability cost: cohort histograms are emitted at an aggregated resolution by default to limit cardinality; configuration knobs added for retention and sample rate. Testing: unit tests for the extractor, integration test validating cohort tags survive sampling, end-to-end dashboard snapshot test, and a smoke run on perf-canary to validate CPU overhead <1%. Related work: follows up on ENG-987 instrumentation spike and complements recent token-attribution work. Checklist: - [x] add token feature extractor and cohort tagging - [x] emit cohorted histograms to telemetry index - [x] implement span-anchoring metadata and join keys - [x] dashboard panels and predefined queries - [x] tests and perf canary runs - [x] runbook notes and quickstart docs
